plain: A government rule that restricts selling certain technology, here advanced AI chips and the machines that make them, to certain countries or buyers.
eli5: A rule that says the shop may not sell its most powerful tools to certain customers.
technical: Licensing requirements on the export, re-export or transfer of controlled items; for AI, chiefly the United States Bureau of Industry and Security's controls on advanced computing chips and semiconductor manufacturing equipment since October 2022.
